item.text:
I traced the issue to [paymentTokenHelper.tsx](/app/packages/components/containers/payments/paymentTokenHelper.tsx:194). `createPaymentToken` accepts `createModal` and builds `PaymentVerificationModal` itself. All five named components pass `createModal` at their token creation call sites.

The chargeable path already returns a `TokenPaymentMethod` immediately. The gap is after tokenization: every other status opens verification, including terminal failure statuses. The fix should move modal handling into `getDefaultVerifyPayment`, bind it through `getCreatePaymentToken`, call verification only for `STATUS_PENDING`, and reject terminal failures.

[process](/app/packages/components/containers/payments/paymentTokenHelper.tsx:79) also needs attention: it currently rejects on tab close and abort, and its polling waits are not cancelled immediately. Existing [helper tests](/app/packages/components/containers/payments/paymentTokenHelper.test.ts:24) assert some of those rejection behaviors, so they conflict with the requested resolution and cleanup semantics. I did not run tests or change project source or tests; this workspace’s specialist instruction limits this pass to diagnosis.
